load_emnlp2017_data: load EMNLP2017 train and validation data from JSON files using get_raw_data with a truncated vocabulary
tokenize_sentence: split a sentence string into word tokens using the tokenize function
convert_strings_to_ids: convert a list of word strings into integer IDs using string_sequence_to_sequence and a word_to_id vocabulary
create_batch_iterator: create a looping batch iterator over sequence data using the iterator function with optional random sampling
build_vocabulary: build a word-to-ID vocabulary from JSON data sorted by token frequency using the internal _build_vocab function
